subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the same adult East Asian female Broadway dancer established by <Picture 1>, preserving her East Asian facial identity, realistic facial features, black elegant updo, glamorous makeup, black-and-gold sequined halter gown, burgundy feather trim, long black opera gloves, high heels, slim body proportions, and overall luxurious stage-performer appearance.
<Picture 2> is the environment and composition reference, preserving the cream-colored pedestal vessel, the mound of white granular material inside the vessel, the rustic wooden base, the dark tea leaves and tray in the foreground, the warm beige textured background, and the sculptural dark branch with the pale flower.

summary:
[reference generation] <Subject 1> appears as a miniature-scale dancer standing on top of the white granular mound inside the pedestal vessel from <Picture 2>. She performs an elegant, sensual Broadway-style dance while continuously facing the camera, maintaining direct eye contact and speaking naturally throughout the performance. Her face remains clearly visible and front-oriented for the entire video.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (entire video): fully_preserved - preserve her East Asian facial identity, facial proportions, hairstyle, makeup, black-and-gold gown, burgundy feather details, black opera gloves, high heels, body proportions, and realistic human appearance. Her identity and costume must not change during movement.
<Picture 2> (entire video environment): fully_preserved - preserve the pedestal vessel, white granular mound, wooden base, tea-leaf arrangement, beige background, dark curved branch, pale flower, spatial layout, warm restrained color palette, and refined minimalist still-life aesthetic.
<Subject 1> relative to <Picture 2>: fully_preserved - she remains miniature in scale and physically stands on top of the white granular material inside the vessel. She must not stand beside, behind, or in front of the vessel and must not grow to normal human scale.

detailed_description:
The target video is a refined surreal luxury-fashion performance with realistic human rendering, soft warm studio lighting, elegant Broadway glamour, and the restrained East-Asian still-life composition established by <Picture 2>. Keep the camera stable and the visual hierarchy clean. <Subject 1> is always the focal point.

[Shot 1] From 00:00.000 to the end of the video, <Subject 1> stands securely on top of the white granular mound inside the cream pedestal vessel from <Picture 2>, appearing miniature relative to the surrounding still-life objects. The camera holds a stable frontal medium-wide composition with a very slow, subtle push-in, keeping her complete body visible together with the vessel and the sculptural branch.

<Subject 1> begins an elegant Broadway-inspired dance directly toward the camera. Her movements are controlled, graceful, feminine, and slightly sensual: she shifts her weight rhythmically from one leg to the other, extends one arm outward, raises the other arm above shoulder level, gently rolls her shoulders, traces smooth curves through the air with her gloved hands, and makes small precise steps on the white mound. Her hips and torso move with restrained musical rhythm while the slit of the gown, sequined fabric, and burgundy feather trim respond naturally with secondary motion.

CRITICAL FACE AND GAZE LOCK: throughout the entire performance, <Subject 1>'s head and face remain oriented toward the camera. Her eyes maintain direct eye contact with the lens. She never turns her back to the camera, never performs a full-body spin, never looks away, never lowers her face for an extended moment, and never allows her hands, hair, feathers, branch, or costume to obscure her face. Her body may angle slightly during dance movements, but her neck and head continuously compensate so that her face stays readable and directed toward the viewer.

While dancing, <Subject 1> speaks naturally to the camera with clear, synchronized lip movement and an expressive but controlled stage-performer delivery. Her mouth movements must remain visible and anatomically natural while the rest of her facial identity stays stable. The woman (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 看着我，这么小的舞台，也一样可以跳得很精彩。</d>

During the spoken line, she keeps direct eye contact, gives a subtle confident smile between phrases, and continues dancing without interrupting the dialogue. The dance never becomes overly fast or acrobatic; prioritize facial stability, readable speech, elegant upper-body movement, and identity consistency. Avoid rapid head shaking, spinning, jumping, back-facing choreography, profile-only poses, or movements that cause facial deformation.

The cream pedestal vessel remains completely stable beneath her. The white granular material reacts only subtly beneath her heels with tiny realistic shifts and compression, without splashing or exploding. The dark sculptural branch and pale flower remain elegant and largely still, with only an extremely subtle natural movement if needed. The background and tabletop arrangement do not transform.

Toward the final seconds, <Subject 1> transitions into a confident finishing pose: one leg slightly forward, torso upright, one gloved arm lifted elegantly and the other extended outward. She is still looking directly into the camera as she finishes her spoken line, holding a poised, glamorous expression while the feather trim and hem settle naturally. End on her face clearly visible, eyes locked on the viewer, standing firmly on top of the vessel.

overall_soundscape:
The woman's clear close-recorded Chinese dialogue is dominant. Add subtle fabric and feather movement, delicate high-heel contact with the white granular surface, faint room ambience, and extremely restrained tabletop/studio environmental sound. No loud impacts or distracting environmental noise.

non_diegetic_music:
A refined, low-volume Broadway-inspired instrumental bed with restrained jazz rhythm, soft piano, brushed percussion, and subtle theatrical strings. Keep the music beneath the dialogue and never overpower the woman's voice.
